evals.prompt: Design an AI model for predicting student dropout risk based on engagement metrics (login frequency, assignment completion rate, quiz scores, forum participation). The model must be explainable to non-technical school administrators.
evals.expected_output: Proposes model architecture with XAI integration (SHAP/LIME), defines feature engineering strategy, includes interpretability layer for admins.
assertions: Proposes a suitable model architecture for tabular prediction (e.g., gradient boosting, neural net)
Integrates explainability tools like SHAP or LIME for model transparency
Designs an interpretable output format accessible to non-technical administrators

evals.prompt: Our RAG pipeline for the educational assistant has a retrieval accuracy of only 62%. Students report getting irrelevant context in responses. Propose improvements to the embedding and retrieval system.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses retrieval issues, proposes hybrid search (dense + sparse), reranking, chunk optimization, and embedding fine-tuning strategies.
assertions: Diagnoses potential causes of low retrieval accuracy (chunk size, embedding quality, indexing)
Proposes hybrid search combining dense and sparse retrieval methods
Recommends a reranking step or embedding fine-tuning to improve relevance

evals.prompt: We want to implement federated learning across 5 partner schools so we can train on their student data without centralizing it. Each school has different data schemas and sizes ranging from 500 to 50,000 students.
evals.expected_output: Designs federated learning architecture, addresses data heterogeneity, proposes schema normalization, handles class imbalance across participants.
assertions: Designs a federated learning architecture with a central aggregation server
Addresses data schema differences with normalization or adapter layers
Handles the significant size imbalance (500 vs 50,000) in aggregation weighting

evals.prompt: Build a knowledge graph for our educational content. We have 5,000 lessons, 20,000 quiz questions, and prerequisite relationships between topics. The graph should power adaptive learning path recommendations.
evals.expected_output: Designs knowledge graph schema with entities and relationships, proposes graph database, defines traversal algorithms for path recommendations.
assertions: Defines entities (lessons, topics, questions) and relationships (prerequisite, covers, assesses)
Recommends a graph database technology for storage and querying
Proposes graph traversal algorithms for adaptive learning path generation

evals.prompt: Our generative AI tutor sometimes halluccinates incorrect math solutions. The hallucination rate is estimated at 8%. Propose a strategy to detect and mitigate hallucinations in real-time.
evals.expected_output: Proposes multi-layer hallucination detection: symbolic verification for math, retrieval grounding, confidence scoring, and human-in-the-loop escalation.
assertions: Proposes symbolic or rule-based verification specifically for mathematical content
Includes retrieval-augmented grounding to verify generated answers against source material
Designs a confidence scoring mechanism with escalation for low-confidence outputs

should_trigger: Design an AI model for predicting student dropout risk with explainability
Our RAG pipeline has low retrieval accuracy, how do we improve it?
Implement federated learning across partner schools without sharing data
Build a knowledge graph for adaptive learning path recommendations
How do we detect and reduce hallucinations in our AI tutor?

Design a React dashboard for teacher analytics

Calculate the unit economics for our SaaS pricing model
